In maplibre::render::view_state

maplibre::render::view_state

Module external 

Source
Expand description

External views: an eye the host places, for head tracking, a stereo pair, or a globe the host set down in its own world.

The host hands over the view matrix it renders with and the eye’s frustum. The map derives its center, zoom and angles from the view matrix, so tile covering and pixel scale follow the eye as they do for the map’s own gestures, and draws with matrices built from the eye itself, in its own units, so the frame matches the host’s frustum whatever way the eye turns.
